name: H. Gilbert
bio: H. Gilbert took part in the April 1884 Republican county convention. In August 1885 he wrote from Sentinel Butte that some of his cattle had died, and investigation pointed to dry murrain.

moments.label: Reported cattle deaths at Sentinel Butte

mentions: H. Gilbert and S. R. Divine, of Sully, were in town Tuesday. Mr. Divine starts for the Cœur D'Alene mines to-night.
